story.what_it_does: ICICI Prudential AMC manages money for investors through mutual funds, portfolio management services (PMS) and alternative funds (AIFs). It earns fees on the assets it manages, which averaged about INR 11.61 lakh crore in the September 2026 quarter. It is the second largest asset manager in India with a 13.3% market share.
story.plans: Management is working to buy the PMS business from ICICI Securities, which still awaits approvals and documentation. An ICICI Venture acquisition is also proposed, subject to approvals. Management declined to size its new SIF or Dubai businesses, and non-cash ESOP costs of about INR 64-68 crore will hit profit in FY27.
story.moat: Its scale and second-place market share (13.3-13.5% over the period) give it a large fee base, with an operating margin of about 37 basis points on assets and return on equity of 85.8% for FY26. It also reports a large customer base of 16.2 million unique customers, though employee count is almost double the next listed rival, which management explained by its alternates business and over-investment.

scenarios.story: Assets keep growing and operating revenue continues to rise in the mid-teens, as it did in FY26 (up 23.1%) and recent quarters (up 16.3%). New areas such as PMS, alternates and the ICICI Venture deal add fees on top of the mutual fund business.
signals_to_watch: Operating revenue growth year on year staying around 16% or higher
Completion of the PMS acquisition from ICICI Securities and the ICICI Venture deal

scenarios.story: Assets and revenue grow more slowly, with AUM growth easing from 25.6% in March 2026 to 14.4% in September 2026. Market share holds near 13.3% and margin stays near 37 basis points, but ESOP costs weigh on profit.
signals_to_watch: Market share of total mutual fund AUM around 13.3%
Operating margin staying near 37 basis points

scenarios.story: Fund flows weaken further as SIP stoppages exceed new SIPs, redemptions rise and debt and advisory assets keep shrinking. Lower fee rates after the regulatory TER change (3-4 basis points gross) and swings in other income could also squeeze profit.
signals_to_watch: SIP stoppages versus new SIPs and redemption levels
Profit after tax growth, which slowed to 6.1% year on year in the September 2026 quarter
